                               company_purchase, company_name, company_ico, company_dic,
                               delivery_address_different, delivery_street, delivery_city, delivery_zip, delivery_country, newsletter_opt_in)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id AS "id!"
